map.繁体算中文吗？: Do Traditional Chinese characters count as Chinese?
map.算。繁体汉字属 CJK 统一区，会被保留；如需简繁分离可先转简再提取。: Yes. Traditional Han characters fall in the CJK Unified block and are kept; to separate Simplified from Traditional, convert first and then extract.
